en.headline: Second large-scale drill held at Huanggang Port Hong Kong side
en.dek: The Security Bureau also launched a dedicated webpage explaining the new co-location facilities, clearance mode and public-transport links ahead of the port’s eventual opening.
body: The Hong Kong side of Huanggang Port staged its second large-scale drill on Saturday, including a cross-department counter-terrorism and major-incident exercise, the Security Bureau said.

The drill tested overall management of passenger and vehicle flows at the joint inspection building and the public transport interchange, aiming to strengthen inter-departmental response capability for unexpected incidents.

Separately, the bureau launched a dedicated webpage on the new port. It provides floor plans of the joint inspection building, explanations and demonstration videos of the “cooperative inspection, one-time release” clearance mode and the five-in-one vehicle inspection arrangement, plus information on public-transport connections and Wi-Fi use.

The bureau said preparations for the port’s commissioning are proceeding intensively and invited the public to familiarise themselves with the arrangements through the new site. Earlier drills involved about 1,000 civil servants testing transport links and internal circulation within the building.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸港方口岸舉行第二次大型演練 保安局推專頁介紹設施
zh.dek: 演練包括跨部門反恐及重大事故演習，測試聯檢大樓及公共運輸交匯處人流車流管理，並加強突發事故應變能力。
body: 特區政府周六在皇崗口岸港方口岸區舉行第二次大型演練，並進行跨部門反恐和重大事故演習，測試口岸聯檢大樓和公共運輸交匯處的人流和車流整體管理，加強各部門面對突發事故的應變能力。
另外，保安局推出皇崗口岸專題網頁，介紹新口岸大樓的設施及全新通關模式等資訊。新專頁提供口岸大樓樓層介紹、「合作查驗、一次放行」及「五合一車檢」的簡介與示範影片、往返口岸的公共交通配套資訊及Wi-Fi使用指南等。
保安局在社交平台表示，正密鑼緊鼓籌備皇崗口岸開通工作，呼籲市民可透過專頁預先了解相關資訊。
早前首次大型演練約有一千名公務員參與，測試不同公共交通工具抵達口岸及大樓內的人流車流安排。
